overview: Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) is a condition where excess fat builds up in the liver in people who drink little or no alcohol, commonly linked to obesity, diabetes, and metabolic syndrome. If left untreated, it can progress from simple fatty liver to inflammation, fibrosis, cirrhosis, and even liver failure.
